QR Grove
Plant a link, watch it grow into a tree — or pick from a dozen other code types. Scanning always goes straight to your link, no redirect hop.
This is encoded directly — scanning goes straight to it, no middle page.
Why no SQRC, Frame QR, or Model 1?
SQRC (secret-key encrypted region) and Denso's Frame QR are proprietary and need Denso's own software, and QR Model 1 (1994) is obsolete — no working open encoder exists for them. For a Frame QR look, use QR Code with the Frame, Logo and Eyes options below: it stays a standard code every phone scans.
Pattern and eyes are available for QR Code, Micro QR and rMQR. This type supports colors, frame and templates.
QR Code only — a logo switches the code to high error-correction. Up to 20% stays reliably scannable.
Brand the whole code
Gradient blends your code color into the accent across every module. Logo fill paints the modules with your logo (darkened so it still scans). Watermark tiles a faint logo behind the code.
Accent color paints the frame. A brand name turns on the banner frame and a signpost in Tree view.
Code color, then background. Keep the code darker than the background.
Never expires
Whatever type you pick, your link is encoded directly into the symbol — position markers, timing patterns and quiet zone are left untouched, and there's no third-party redirect service in between. Decoration is layered on top, never in place of, the data.
planting: https://claude.ai

Shrink a link

      
This compresses your link and encodes it right into the address itself — the destination lives inside the link, not in a database. There's nothing to expire or go offline; the link works for as long as this page does.
